description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees and partners through transformative communications experiences.

Vonage API solutions empower organisations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure, allowing them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel, including voice, video and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock and much more.

Why this role matters:

Vonage works with carrier partners and holds licences to operate as a carrier or service provider in several countries, enabling us to deliver a growing portfolio of Carrier Services to customers around the world.

As a Numbers Analyst, you will help deliver and manage numbers, short codes and associated services across Vonage Number Inventory, API, Contact Center and other businesses. You will take ownership of assigned operational work, partnering with carriers and internal teams to ensure orders are implemented accurately, inventory is available, and service issues are investigated and resolved. Your work supports reliable customer service and the continued growth of Vonage Carrier Services.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Own assigned number and short code provisioning requests from intake through implementation, maintaining accurate records and keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
  • Monitor number inventory and coordinate restocking to support business and customer demand.
  • Test newly provisioned numbers and services, investigate faults, and coordinate troubleshooting through to resolution.
  • Process and implement customer orders submitted through Sales or directly by customers, checking request details and resolving gaps with the relevant teams.
  • Support customer issue resolution, taking responsibility for follow-up and escalating complex or time-sensitive issues appropriately.
  • Contribute to CPaaS CSP onboarding, testing and service design activities, coordinating operational readiness with internal teams and carrier partners.
  • Work across Support, Legal, Operations, Sales and other teams to maintain clear communication and continuity of service.
  • Build effective day-to-day working relationships with carrier partners and contribute to the resolution of operational matters.
  • Provide information and supporting records for audits and regulatory inquiries, working with compliance colleagues as required.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and opportunities for automation and contribute to improvements that streamline workflows and strengthen service quality.

What you'll bring

Required:

  • Experience in a telecoms, carrier services, contact centre or related operational environment.
  • Working knowledge of telephony or messaging services, with the ability to investigate provisioning and service issues methodically.
  • A reliable, organised approach and the ability to manage assigned work independently, prioritise competing requests and follow through to completion.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to coordinate effectively with customers, carrier partners and colleagues across different functions.
  • Good attention to detail when processing orders, updating service information and preparing operational records.
  • A practical, continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to contribute to better processes and automation.

Experience we consider a plus:

  • Experience with Zendesk, Atlassian Jira or Confluence.
  • Experience with Salesforce and Microsoft Office.
  • Exposure to SQL or data tools such as Kibana, Snowflake or MySQL.
  • Experience supporting carrier onboarding, number provisioning, short codes or CPaaS services.

How You Will Benefit

  • Medical Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Ericsson Care Line
  • Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process #LI-ML1

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice. 

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.
